name: San Bernardino Public Library Volunteers (13 and up)
org: San Bernardino Public Library (City of San Bernardino)
what_you_do: Help at the city library. You might read at story time for kids, help in the local history room, or help people learn to read.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 and up. Under 18 needs a parent or guardian's OK. You must pass a Live Scan background check. Court ordered hours are not allowed.
duration: At least 4 hours a month, for a total of 24 hours every 6 months.
deadline_text: No deadline. Apply any time. The background check can take 2 to 3 weeks.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online Volunteer Application. If the library picks you, the city sets up a Live Scan background check. When you are cleared, you go to an orientation.
notes: Volunteers get a record of hours and can ask for a letter of recommendation. Students can do school service hours here.
